com.github.mangstadt.vinnie

Class LaciToken

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.github.mangstadt.vinnie.LaciToken
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    CharSequence, Comparable<LaciToken>

    public final class LaciToken
extends Object
implements CharSequence, Comparable<LaciToken>

    A Locale-Agnostic, Case-Insensitive string. Used for string values that must remain machine-readable under all locales and letter casings (upper/lower).

    Uses Locale.ROOT when converting to upper/lower case to avoid issues where some English characters are converted to non-English characters under certain locales. Letter casing of the source string is not retained. All comparisons are case-insensitive.

    Author:
    Michael Angstadt
    See Also:
    String.toLowerCase(Locale), "https://github.com/mangstadt/vinnie/pull/5"
